notes.title: ESDigital Games Reveals Exciting Gamescom Line-up!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to reveal our [b]2024 Gamescom lineup[/b], with some stellar titles showcasing never-before-seen gameplay in both the Business and Consumer halls at this year’s event!

[previewyoutube=LlQ6vq4RCJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Gamers heading to [b]Gamescom[/b] will have the chance to get hands-on with some truly exciting titles covering all kinds of genres! Located in the bustling [b]Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019)[/b] we will be showcasing brand new game demos for [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade, Steel Seed, Island of Winds, BattleJuice Alchemist and Sky of Tides[/b].

There will also be the chance to snap a picture with two awesome cosplayers portraying the protagonists [b]Tania from AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b] and [b]Zoe from Steel Seed[/b] as well as grabbing some cool branded merchandise after trying out the hands-on demos.

In addition to the Indie Arena Booth, our team will also have playable demos for [b]Cats on Duty, Memory Lost, and REMEDIUM[/b] on the [b]Polish Indie Booth (Hall 10.2, F-041)[/b] for fans to try out! 

[h3]More information on the great games available to play at Gamescom:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458430/Steel_Seed/

[b]Steel Seed (Storm in Teacup Studio)[/b] is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion. Use Zoe's parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. Don't forget about stealth-based techniques to explore the facility's hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. Also, get acquainted with KOBY, because he is the master key of Steel Seed and Zoe's guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689340/Island_of_Winds/

[b]Island of Winds (Parity Games Studio)[/b] is an adventure game set in a fantastical world inspired by 17th century Iceland and its folklore. Experience the story of Brynhildur, a Balance Keeper who embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Core gameplay involves intriguing puzzles, spellcasting, and a focus on empathy encounters. The core gameplay involves spellcasting, intriguing puzzles, fantastical lore, and a special focus on approaching encounters with empathy. Island of Winds features a semi-open world environment that explores themes of self-doubt, violence, regret and empathy, as well as the conservation of nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

[b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade (Dark Pigeon Games)[/b]. Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale 2D action-platformer metroidvania. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place? Slain your foes with a wide range of combos: from fastest to slowest. Parry enemy attacks to gain an advantage, use Fast Stand Up ability to get back into the fight and dash into enemies while they're attacking to slow the world around you and gain damage immunity. Combos and Skills will also help you to break through hordes of enemies and defeat bosses. Control the course of the story, help Tania make choices at the crucial moments of the game and take your own path to reveal mysteries of the past and present. Different routes may lead you to different endings. Search the Horace Islands for clues and information about mysterious and dangerous world of the AWAKEN - Astral Blade.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

[b]Sky of Tides (Lofty Sky Entertainment Studio)[/b] is a sci-fi narrative game set in a technologically advanced universe on the brink of war. Play as Rin, who must search for her missing father and heal the broken planet of Numen. Explore the world while your choices shape your character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384060/BattleJuice_Alchemist/

[b]BattleJuice Alchemist (Alchemical Works Studio)[/b] is a complex alchemy RPG that adds a unique item and skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on isometric combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, build a tower and craft potions to fight the demonic hordes of Samhain. Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top down view and in bullet-time close combat. Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist's deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[h3]Additionally, there are opportunities for hands-on with these titles:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/

[b]REMEDIUM[/b] is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter set in a grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. A special build for journalists, with all acts available + some never before seen new acts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447260/Cats_on_Duty/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

notes.title: REMEDIUM Act 2 - New Content Released Today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]the first content update of Act 2 for REMEDIUM[/b]!

Today’s content update is the first stage in the full Act 2 release, including a new location, new mutant types, boss and new story content being made available for players to experience. A further two locations, enemy types, bosses and additional story arcs will be released over the coming weeks to complete the full Act 2 launch.

[previewyoutube=bm1crfsWnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pleased to announce that [b]there will be NO price increase for REMEDIUM following today’s content update[/b]. The price will only increase when we are happy with the content and quality of the game in general and Act 2 in particular. For now, the focus is delivering the most polished and content-complete version of the game during its Steam Early Access phase.  

Since the launch of Act 1, we’ve been busy gathering your feedback and introducing many quality-of-life improvements and new features, many of which were requested by players already active on the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include the balancing of battles to make weak enemies more dynamic, a reworked dash movement, new enemy spawn mechanics, improved VFX, blood effects and HUD, as well as many other cosmetic enhancements to the game world. We will continue to work with the community on today’s update to improve and polish the upcoming content ahead of the full Act 2 release and extend our thanks for the support and feedback on REMEDIUM’s Early Access launch so far and look forward to further collaboration throughout the development journey.

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with your journal, you must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, which must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

[h3]REMEDIUM Act 2 features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 2 will introduce three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
[*] Today’s update unveils the new Fort location along with new mutants and boss type - Despite their beast-like looks these mutants wear armor and use human weapons like clubs, spears and even mortars. They inhabit a ruined fortress nestled into the mountainside protected by a deadly new boss. Mutant types: Grunt, Pikeman, Gunner. Boss: Huntress. Two more locations (Mine and Abbey), mutant types and bosses, will complete Act 2 and be released soon.
[*] Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
[*] Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customize them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
[*] Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
[*] An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
[*] Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
[*] Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. [/list]

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist transmutes into action!
notes.content:
[i]ESDigital Games[/i] and [i]Alchemical Works[/i] are delighted to reveal their action adventure RPG title [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b] and its new announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=_JlygN27g1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds an equipment-based skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on top-down combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, and craft potions to fight demonic hordes overrunning the lands.

Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice, you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top-down view and in bullet-time close combat.

Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist’s deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469214/3a29e0c41079d009f23b3a23afabdb7c86aa9d70.jpg[/img]

[h3]UNIQUE ITEMS AND CHARACTER BUILDS[/h3]
[b]Loot and Craft[/b]: As an alchemist you wear no armor and wield no sword, but you rain down fire on your enemies. Find flasks with unique properties in the wilderness or craft them at your workbench. In deck-building fashion you create a compilation of flasks which you randomly draw from.

[b]Unique Skill System[/b]: In BattleJuice Alchemist, your flasks are your skills. Every flask can be used the normal way and at times in a supercharged, "jucified" way for stronger effects. Some flasks have powers attached to them that drastically change their effects when used, which allows you to develop your own playstyle.

[h3]EXPLORE A DARK WORLD[/h3]
[b]Procedural Landscapes, Hand-crafted Towns[/b]: The world of BattleJuice Alchemist is separated into vast levels of procedural landscape. Every valley, sea, river, mountain, building, stone, tree and item is placed by a unique algorithm. This allows you to continue exploring after you completed the main story. Quest locations are still hand-crafted to tell compelling stories.

[b]Dark Lands to Discover[/b]: You are influenced by daytime and weather effects and so are your enemies. But they are also buffed by the evermore spawning demons’ presence. Find dark altars to hold their influence at bay and discover many other secrets.

[h3]ENGAGING COMBAT[/h3]
[b]Classic isometric ARPG action[/b]: Fight your enemies from afar in classic top down view. Throw explosive or freezing flasks at them, prepare ambushes of explosive barrels. Use the “Frog Hop” flask to jump away from danger or right into close combat.

[b]Close Combat with Bullet-time[/b]: Enter close combat with an enemy, where you can interact hands on by dodging or using smoke flasks to avoid being hit. Manage your resources and flasks during these intense one on one battles against your awe-inspiring enemies from the Crossroads.

notes.title: BUCK REWORK AND MAGNUS CARDS CHANGES (BETA)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/e44982b2d0d2d4f6328d58e631bf55cdc18acb47.jpg[/img]

[h1]ALL CHANGES AFFECTS ONLY MAGNUS PUBLIC BETA IN STEAM[/h1]

[h3]We invite you to join the discussion of Magnus Beta test in our Discord:[/h3]
https://discord.gg/AgDPcP

To participate in the open Beta test, you should simply choose [b]magnus_public_beta[/b] in Steam client. Instructions in two easy steps can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1016730/announcements/detail/1714114646536691321

[h3][b]Crossroads Keeper[/b] - rework![/h3]

The boss' skills, as before, are aimed at making deals with the player, the value of which can both help and hurt the player. However, the Crossroads Keeper now has a deadly and tricky set of skills.

With each move, the Crossroads Keeper offers the player one of three deals. The player is able to wish for eternal life, glory and wealth or unlimited power.
[list]
[*] [b]Wish of Eternal Life[/b] - Restores 30 health. Before the boss's next move, the player takes twice as much damage;
[*] [b]Wish of Infinite Power[/b] - Increases Strength by 3 for two turns. After three turns, the player receives Stun;
[*] [b]Wish of Glory and Wealth[/b] - Restores 10 cards from the Ash Deck. The Crossroads  Keeper restores 2 health for each card he returned.
[/list]
Crossroads Master now applies one of the random types of periodic damage: bleeding, poisoning, or burning.
Every 6 turns, the Boss deals 1 damage 6 times. In this scenario, for example, bleeding can be your last stop.
If there are more cards in the Ash deck than in a Battle deck, the Crossroads Keeper will punish you, inflicting 66 hellish damage!

[h3]Magnus' cards changes[/h3] 

[b]Phantom archetype balance adjusted[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Summon Doppelganger[/b] card now costs 3 mana, instead of 4;
[*] The Phantom base attack has been strengthened;
[*] Cards that add combat skills to Phantom now do more damage;
[*] Trait a [b]Tough Doppelganger[/b] giving the Phantom 125 Health now gives 150, which extends its existence on the battlefield for one more round.
[/list]
In the next updates, you will find the processing of the Eruption, as well as improvements of Magnus' cards

[h3]Previously unpublished changes[/h3]

notes.title: MAGNUS' ARCHETYPES
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/452ad476b8af86a15058d1c1c842be71384b0a8b.jpg[/img]

Here are the archetypes of cards and game mechanics of our new shapeshifter character. Get to know Magnus the Ugly Jester!

[h1]CURSES[/h1]

The first and main archetype: "Curses". Its idea is that the player imposes on opponents debuffs, each of which slightly reduces the characteristics of the monsters (Speed, Strenght, Critical chance, and Dodge chance - moreover, the Strenght can take negative values, which will weaken monster attacks!). The effects of the Curses are summarizable, so the more it will be imposed on the enemy, the greater debuff the enemy will receive. Also, in addition to passive effects, Curses can be removed, applying massive damage to your opponent.

[h1]OBEDIENCE[/h1]

The second archetype: "Obedience" allows the player to control the mind of opponents, forcing them to attack their allies or even themselves. The power of attack depends on the new parameter that was introduced in the game - [b]the rank of the monster.[/b] For example, regular enemies like Wolves or Possessors have the "Weak" rank, while larger and more dangerous monsters like Chimeras or Corpse Wagons have the "Strong" rank. Consequently, the more powerful the monster is, the stronger are the effects of Obedience. This is one of the most unique game mechanics we have planned since we started developing the game!

[h1]PHANTOM[/h1]

The third archetype: "Phantom." Now you will be able to summon your own personal monster, who will protect you until his death! The Phantom cannot be attacked by most monster attacks and each move loses its health. Your servant can perform both simple attacks and more complex combat combinations. For example: Initially Phantom has only primitive attack skills, but with the help of cards of this archetype player can expand his skill set, giving the personal monster additional passive properties, such as "Defender", and even the possibility of treatment at the expense of the Health of a servant!

[h1]SHAPESHIFTER[/h1]

In conclusion, we want to talk about one of the Magnus' most important features.

Each battle Magnus will begin in the human form of Jester, in which archetype Curse cards cost 1 less mana. For the fourth round, the character will be transformed into one of two random monstrous shapes - the shape of Wrath or the shape of Fear, each of which reduces the cost of cards corresponding to Magnus' archetype (Phantom or Obedience). This is valid for 3 rounds, after which the character returns to his basic form. It is worth noting that each of the three shapes, in addition to the positive effect, will also have a negative, so the player will have to constantly adapt to a specific combat situation. Due to the peculiarity of Magnus' gameplay, the need for a precise combination of cards becomes vital. There will be a lot of variations to achieve victory!

Magnus' release will take place at the end of December in [b]beta format[/b]. 

[b]What does that mean?[/b]
[list]
[*] Some content, like the art of cards, may not be available;
[*] We will listen to the community very carefully;
[*] We'll be balancing Magnus until the game's full release.
[/list]

[h1]BONUS![/h1]

[b]Hard path:[/b] at the end of the path an additional Boss will be waiting for you;

[b]Easy path:[/b] There are no additional complications. Use this way as a respite from the hard way.

notes.title: THE BUCK SKILLS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/ea5728148e2191e1ff8b6c4e8975069fad9647c6.jpg[/img]

The Buck's release is coming, which means it's time to unveil the veil of secrecy and tell you a little about our new characters archetypes.

Unlike the fast and dexterous Sly, [b]Buck[/b] using less cards in the battle, but his strength and fury knows no bounds. Buck's cards cost significantly more mana, but the effect will [b]make your enemies shudder[/b].

[h1]The First Archetype - [b]Berserker[/b][/h1]

The less Health [b]Buck[/b] has, the more powerful his attacks become. The cards of this archetype receive more substantial bonuses for Strength, and Strength, in turn, increases with a decrease in Health.
This tactic encourages you to play on the edge for the sake of inflicting huge damage.
An integral part of this archetype is a new type of periodic damage - [b]Inflammation[/b]. The effect of this skill is enhanced with each move, but unlike [b]Bleeding[/b], the effect of [b]Inflammation[/b] has its limit. In addition, the rate of inflammation can be reset, for example, by healing.

[h1]The Second Archetype - [b]Execution[/b][/h1]

The cards of this archetype receive bonuses for killing enemies and attacking monsters with a small amount of Health. If Berserker pushes you to play “on the edge”, the [b]Execution[/b] offers a different strategy: first weaken the enemy, and then bring down the full power of the [b]Execution[/b] on him. By the way, you can not only increase your attack for striking dying enemies, but also get a [b]Shield[/b] for killing or [b]Stun[/b] creatures remaining on the battlefield. It is worth mentioning that this archetype also has a synergy with the [b]Inflammation[/b] effect.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

Oops, it seems we overdid in some way: the bug on the levels of difficulty [b]Adventurer[/b] and [b]Martyr[/b] with a critically small dropp of keys for a chests was fixed. Now you'll get the keys you deserve!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/d2ce4d3820c011c5601c85f0b95259f5e6f3b526.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, friends!

For a long time we worked hard to produce as much new content as we can trying to make your game's opportunities as wide as possible. As a result, the [b]Deck of Ashes[/b] became much larger which affected the game balance. So the in-game economy was most affected feature. Let's begin! :)

[h1]THE ECONOMY BALANCE FIXES[/h1]

The main problems associated with the economy disbalance, we considered an excessively large number of resources available to the player and duration of a storyline campaign. A lot of work was produced.

[h1]Prepare to tighten the belts[/h1]
[list]
[*] The number of chests, especially with 3 keys was reduced;
[*] The amount of Ash storms is slightly reduced;
[*] The ratio of the number of teleports has been changed. Now you will see more teleports in the red zone than in the yellow one;
[*] Slightly reduced the number of battles and the chance of Ambush;
[*] Fights rewards was reduced;
[*] An amount of extractable resources was reduced;
[*] The size of the dungeons in all chapters and the amount of resources, battles and chests inside were reduced;
[*] The duration of the second chapter is slightly reduced;
[*] Creating cards on a camp now costs less ash than the Blacksmith in Camp.
[/list]
Despite such a big changes, the updated economy balance is an improved and more sparing version of the one that was when the game came out in early access. And, as a good game is supposed to be, the updated economy balance is friendlier to the new players, but now it is quite capable of challenging the masters of the [b]Deck of Ashes[/b] :)

[b]An important note:[/b]

The new economy balance is available only at the difficulty levels [b]Adventurer[/b] and [b]Martyr.[/b] Difficulty levels [b]Wanderer[/b] and [b]Raider[/b] will maintain the previous balance of power, taking in itself only a decrease in the duration of the second chapter and the size of the dungeons.

[h1]NEW SPEED MODE[/h1]

You asked a lot about this, friends. We have heard you. Thank you :))

[b]The general pace of the game has been increased, as well as its individual elements:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The speed of changing of turn was accelerated;
[*] The speed of playing cards by the enemy was accelerated;
[*] The interface animations were accelerated;
[*] Moving around the in-game map, as well as a large number of small details were accelerated.
[/list]
You still can turn off the [b]Quick mode[/b] in the settings. It would return the speed of the game that was before the update.

[h1]NEW ANIMATIONS OF MONSTERS AND CHARACTERS[/h1]

And here is the cherry on the top! More than [b]60[/b] new animations were added in the game!

With this update, [b]characters, bosses and all monsters[/b] will receive unique animations of [b]non-attacking[/b] abilities that trigger during summoning, healing, and power-ups.

[list]

Hello everyone!

We hope that the achievement for the last Event is already in your pocket and you are in anticipation of something new!

[b]Meet the new in-game feature:[/b]

[h1]CONSUMABLE ITEMS[/h1]

You can purchase these items for gold and use them in the any battle. The variability of the effects of consumable items is quite wide, so you can follow your own strategy to fight monsters. Here we go:

🐺 Tired of fighting with a summon Beasts? Use the [b]Dog Whistle[/b]. It'll not allow Beasts to call for the reinforcement.
🐞 Tired of endless diseases in your deck? Take the lead: use the [b]Antibacterial Bandage[/b].
ːsteammockingː Can't hit the damn ghosts? Take the [b]Dream Catcher[/b] with you. The spooky guys will never forget it!

Experiment, try different combinations of cards and potions and find your own playstyle!

Consumable items are located in the Merchant's store. There are 25 different consumable items in the shop. However, you can buy only 3 items of each type per day.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/124defdef3a204fe28d6027454b2963a84da9da0.jpg[/img]

[b]Please welcome! NEW character! Sly the Black Serpent! [/b]

Hurry up to update the game and try out the new character! New unique cards archetypes, new strategies and new story chapter!  

To celebrate the introduction of Sly, [b]Deck of Ashes[/b] is on sale for [b]15%[/b] off of its normal price for a limited time on Steam ːsteamhappyː

[h1] WHO IS SLY? [/h1]

💀Sly turned to the dark side after his innocent wife was executed for crimes of the rich and powerful. Striking form the shadows, he took his revenge on the rich offenders, the poor accomplices, and everyone in between. 

With his moral compass destroyed, he turned to the path of robbery and unquenchable bloodthirst, and formed the gang of Outcasts. In their pursuit of power and twisted justice, eventually they released the Ash Curse upon the land. Corrupted by the Curse, Sly was consumed by shadows. The shadows granted him an ability to move unseen, superhuman speed and reflexes.

Yet, shadows brought the voices along. The voices of those slain by his hand. Threatening, moaning, accusing. They drive Sly insane, and he sets out to find Lady Death to make the voices disappear, with the help of mysterious Ash Master, a prophet with unknown past and ulterior motives. When two snakes journey into the Valley of Death, anything can happen.


[h1] CARD ARCHETYPES [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/e2192f01d83abafce547b799ac269e8aa16b7a86.png[/img]

🗡First archetype is based on the weakening of opponents - Bleeding plays an important role in it, it is periodic damage that can be increased with the help of attacks with the Strike type cards. Also, this archetype includes poisoning and stunning targets and is designed for the accumulation of negative effects on opponents.

🃏The second archetype is based on the creation of fragile copies. This is based on the fact that it can generate multiple cards, and this can be recreated in each new battle.

⚡The third archetype is special. It is based on non-playable cards. The effects of these cards work when they get drawn into the hand. A player doesn't need to play them out, so mana is not required. But everything has its own cons: non-playable attacking cards of this archetype affects either all opponents at once or random single ones. With this you are not be able to choose a specific opponent as a target. Remember this tip.

[h1]BATTLE NOTES[/h1]

Please note that despite the recent release of Draft Mode, for the first playthrough we recommend to start the game with a standard deck. It will help you to understand better Sly's gameplay and mechanics of his cards :))

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/679e5cbdbf88fa5733452382dabd938ab3145a74.jpg[/img]

Hi, everybody!

Update 171 brings a new exploration feature - Dungeons.

Dungeons are a new way to gather resources, find card recipes and explore the world in a relaxed way, since when you enter dungeons, Act bosses can no longer find you!

[h1]How to enter[/h1]

You can descent into dungeons by reaching a new tile:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/401a5ea3223ad1c3f39c83746befae3abb66fd28.jpg[/img]

Once you enter a dungeon, the boss bar at the top will stop, and you can freely explore the dungeon. When you complete or exit the dungeon, the boss bar will resume its progress.

[h1]What’s inside[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/184ab2f5bb3a20908745bf45eaddbc980b8d9f37.jpg[/img]

Inside dungeons you will find resources, events and battles, with a special enemy at the end - a Dungeon Lord. Beating the Dungeon Lord will unlock a Dungeon Chest with 1 epic card!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/1dffa5bc6e896fa55f041ebf8ae323578a60d884.jpg[/img]

[h1]Heroic Dungeons[/h1]

Starting from Act 2 you can also choose to enter either a Normal or Heroic dungeon:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/a76cf7d153d5d2a3a5c8d431dad4945ae733b3cd.jpg[/img]

Heroic dungeons have harder enemies, but they also give you double rewards and you will find 2 chests instead of 1 after beating the Dungeon Lord, this means 2 Epics per dungeon!

[h1]BEWARE:[/h1]

Choosing dungeon type will lock it to that version - if you pick Heroic dungeon, it can’t be changed back to Normal, and if you choose Normal, it can’t be changed into Heroic later!

[h1]How to exit[/h1]

When you beat the Dungeon Lord or if you go back to the entrance you can exit the dungeon by using the door. You can also use a new icon next to your Travel Stone - it will teleport you out of the dungeon back to the world map.

[h1]NEW ARCHETYPE: PYROBOMB[/h1]

This archetype includes 10 new cards, which are closely connected to each other by a new term in the game - Pyrobomb. Pyrobomb does periodic damage, with a delayed detonation at the end of its duration. When applied, Pyrobomb does 3 damage to the target each turn, for 4 turns, and at the start of the 4th turn it detonates for 12 extra damage. Most of the new cards interact with Pyrobomb in different ways, and many have an additional effect.

Let’s look at a couple of examples:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/d23b6604b779f1d02c9cd36318daa77135a45e95.png[/img]

[b][Stun Bomb] [/b]
Apply Pyrobomb on the opponent.
After triggering any Pyrobomb, put a Stun on the character on whom it worked.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/1af27e5240cf585ec665886f58cadb0c0daab230.png[/img]

[b][Explosion Protection][/b]
Choose an opponent. Get a Shield for each Pirobomb applied on him.

Pyrobomb works well with the archetype's cards, but it’s also good for mixing with other decks, you need only to find the right recipe and craft the cards using it.

Pyrobomb has a more passive playstyle than other archetypes - you apply many Pyrobombs on different targets and complement the strategy with additional effects, like healing and shields.

[h1]NEW FEATURE: SPACE BAR[/h1]

With EA update 169 a brand new feature was added to the game - now pressing Space Bar in different situations will have an effect:

[list]
[*] Confirm card selection in battles
[*] Skip enemy animations in battles
[*] End your turn, return phase in battle
[*] Skip NPC dialogue (camp, map, battle)
[*] Close tutorial messages, Boss messages
[*] Jump to the end of the Ash Storm animation
[/list]

We hope you will like the new additional way to control the game!

notes.title: Building the Deck of Ashes. Part I: Recipes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/f9497b5058293b1750842dadbd1474ecf722c54d.png[/img]

Hi there!

We are excited to start a series of posts about deck-building in Deck of Ashes! So let's dive right in!

First, let's get the basics out of the way.


What is your Battle Deck? Why build a deck at all?

You fight monsters by playing cards. At the very beginning of the game, you have a starting Battle Deck, consisting of basic cards. It’s weak and unlikely to get you far. You can strengthen the deck by adding powerful cards to it. And that's where the deck-building part comes to light!

When talking about building a deck, probably the first question that pops into one's mind is 'How do we get cards to build a deck from?' And that's exactly the topic of today's discussion.


How do you get cards in Deck of Ashes?

Well, the short and vague answer would be 'You don't get cards at all'. (Wait, what?!) 
'Well, it's not the cards you get. You get recipes for cards.' (Wait-wait-wait, it doesn't clarify the matter at all!)

Okay, okay. A card recipe is a consumable item required to craft a single copy of a card. So, you want to add a card that you like to your deck. You have found its recipe and have the necessary resources - you are all set, craft the card and add it to your deck!


Why go with recipes? Why not simply give a card?

We tried many things (and will continue in Early Access) to get the deck-building mechanic just right in Deck of Ashes. And the main design principle we get across was 'You are the Master of your Deck'.


Our objective here was:

- to reward people for smart deck-building
- to give people time to test and refine their deck
- to give people a reliable way to remove cards from the deck that didn't work for them
- to give people great options when they add cards to their deck
- to enable people to set their own goals and hunt for the cards they want for their deck


The recipes served us really well in achieving the objectives above. They give you the power to pursue and build just the deck you want!

In most other deck-building games, sometimes you get a particular card as an option to add to your deck, and you love the card, but your deck doesn't have cards that work with this card at all. So you have two options, both unfun in their own way.

Option 1: you are adding the dead card to your deck hoping to get the cards that work with it later. But if you don't, it remains the dead card and hurts you every time you draw it in battle.

Option 2: you pick something else and just wait for the stars to align next time. It's a bummer that you were forced to do something opposite of what you really wanted.

That's one of the reasons we offer you recipes instead of cards. Just take the recipe of the desired card and hunt for recipes other cards that work with it.


Recipes are also great for another huge reason. They give you options. Say, you have resources to craft only a single card. And you want to make sure it's the best card available. And you've got 5 recipes to choose from! Assess every possibility and make a choice. Making choices is fun, and we felt like the recipes are a great fit for the game for this reason.


Next time we'll talk about how to get the recipes, and the card hunt!


TL;DR
In Deck of Ashes, you don't get cards. You get recipes that allow you to craft specific cards and grant great flexibility in how to build your deck.
Cheers!

notes.title: Pyromancer is officially announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/4f2754fa7aadda59c01415fad1e45dc4f045a888.jpg[/img]The people with a magical gift have always had a target on their backs. Lucia, the impulsive girl, learned to conceal her talents the hard way. She trusted a man once. And he brought back the entire village armed with pitchforks and torches.

Then she joined the Outcasts. After they accidentally released the Ash Curse, she’s become the witch to burn. And before long, she was. But the Curse affected her in an unexpected and twisted way.

She burned alive and died to the cheerful cries of peasants. But as they thought that the show was over, she rose from the ashes, screaming and delivering swift vengeance. The Curse had made her the Flame itself.

But now Lucia’s body is stuck in her dying moment. Each passing second, a reminder of how it feels to burn alive.

The pain drives her mad, but now she has the power. She is the Pyromancer. 
And she will burn everything in her way to regain rest and peace.

And the most important!


Features:

1. Feel the Burn: Set your enemies on fire and watch them turn into a pile of ashes.
2. Strength Comes From Pain: Incinerate your enemies extra fast at the cost of your own health.
3. The Ultimate Sacrifice: Set your precious cards and deck on fire to obtain obscenely powerful effects.
